## Validation

- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes.
- [ ] Public API changes include an accepted RFC and Changeset.
- [ ] Security-boundary changes include threat-model coverage.
- [ ] Documentation and migration guidance are updated.
- [ ] No generated output, secrets, dependencies, or temporary files are committed.
